news.headline: Wednesday's July CPI is the week's big test
news.why: Stocks sit near records after the weak jobs report; core CPI is seen easing to ~2.5% YoY. A hot number would likely trigger a selloff; a soft one cements rate-cut bets.

news.headline: A weak-labor-market read has all but killed rate-hike talk
news.why: July payrolls fell 23k and wage growth hit a ~5-year low, so the Fed's next move is now framed as cut-or-hold, not hike — CPI/PPI this week are the confirmation.

news.headline: Earnings winding down: CoreWeave, Cisco, Applied Materials on deck
news.why: A lighter but AI-heavy earnings week keeps the data-center trade in focus alongside the inflation prints.

news.headline: Alibaba launches Qwen3.8-Max, its most capable model yet
news.why: It claims performance rivaling top US and Chinese systems — the frontier race is now very much global.

news.headline: DeepSeek V4 Flash: near-frontier coding at ~99% less cost
news.why: It approaches top-tier coding quality for a fraction of the price — part of a price war (OpenAI, Gemini Flash, Meta, Grok) that makes cheap, capable models the norm for builders like you.

news.headline: As models converge, 'pick by cost, not brand' — and routers rise
news.why: With quality gaps narrowing, smart model-routing (auto-pick the best model per task) is emerging as the real edge — worth knowing for your app projects.

news.headline: Gaza ceasefire deal moves toward implementation
news.why: Under the deal, Hamas disarms while Israel halts strikes and withdraws; an international force (Uganda, Morocco pledging troops) would secure the territory.

news.headline: Shipping risk lingers in the Strait of Hormuz
news.why: After tankers were struck last week, insurers and energy markets are watching the chokepoint closely — a swing factor for oil (and gas) prices.

news.headline: Europe's heatwave grinds on
news.why: Italy has posted red heat alerts for a record number of cities as southern Europe bakes through a brutal stretch.
